title: Molly's Hill
summary: Molly's Hill is a remembered Montaukett place near the meeting of Fireplace Road and Gerard Drive in Springs. Jacqueline Overton's 1963 local history associates the hill with Molly Pharoah and the early life of her son, Stephen Talkhouse Pharoah. Later road construction altered the hill and its surrounding landscape.
why_this_matters: Although the physical landscape at the intersection of Fireplace Road and Gerard Drive was eventually leveled, the name Molly's Hill preserves the memory of the nineteenth-century Montaukett woman who lived there. Keeping this localized history alive honors the specific, enduring presence of Native women who maintained their ancestral ties in the midst of expanding white settlements.
history_content: Overton described Stephen's childhood with his mother, Molly, near the old and new Fireplace roads. Her account says the hill and traces of the family home were later lost when the road was cut through. Details preserved only in this later local history are presented as Overton's account rather than as independently confirmed facts.
